imported_evidence: NASA reports an Odyssey reaction-wheel malfunction, science paused, and continuing recovery tests. The event motivates the decision only.
engineering_inputs: Every CSV/JSON duration, power, efficiency, capacity, SOC and limit is synthetic; none is an Odyssey specification or observation.
modeled_outputs: Minimum boundary energy, feasible reacquisition-delay samples, forward SOC and unserved energy; no measured power results.
reference_frame: Lumped electrical bus; no spatial coordinate frame or ephemeris
time_scale: Elapsed SI seconds; calendar event dates are context only
licenses: Source is linked and factual metadata paraphrased; no article text or imagery redistributed. Synthetic inputs and code use repository license.
uncertainty: Deterministic capacity and generation stress grid, not a probability distribution or confidence interval
